688:t_3:106.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's when I had the idea of becoming a Reactor myself, nya~.」

688:t_3:107.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So I set my sights on the $$いがみ合う双子$$ and built $$ジェニオン$$ as a machine to steal it.」

688:t_3:108.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「And the pilot I chose was Miss $$スズネ$$, nya~.」

688:t_3:109.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Because the other personality sleeping inside me was one of the $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$s, correct?」

688:t_3:111.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That $$アムブリエル$$... was $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$...」

688:t_3:112.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Correct. She ignored our call to unite our consciousnesses and lay half-asleep within $$西条涼音$$.」

688:t_3:113.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The fragmented memories inside me... Most of them must be hers, linked to $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.」

688:t_3:114.en:
$n
「Could the anxiety you were feeling, Miss $$スズネ$$, have been...」

688:t_3:115.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... It was probably about the despairing future she learned of through $$黒の英知$$...」

688:t_3:116.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And I think that, as she emerged, I separated from her and was freed from that anxiety.」

688:t_3:117.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I see... So she, too, was tormented by the despairing future...」

688:t_3:118.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But she loves freedom more than anything.」

688:t_3:119.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Even to escape that future, even if you're her counterpart from a parallel world, you cannot make her obey.」

688:t_3:120.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Even so, I thought things would change if she awakened to the power of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$.」

688:t_3:121.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「So I... sent 'that' along with $$ジェニオン$$ as an alarm clock, nya~.」

688:t_3:122.en:
$n
「You mean... what I touched before I boarded $$ジェニオン$$...」

688:t_3:123.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That was a fragment of $$黒の英知$$.」

688:t_3:125.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Your Boost Up ability is its effect.」

688:t_3:126.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So that power of yours really didn't come from a $$スフィア$$, $n...」

688:t_3:127.en:
$$ランド$$
「No wonder it was different from ours.」

688:t_3:128.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You know what happened after that.」

688:t_3:129.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Some unforeseen things happened, but you even achieved $$真化融合$$! Splendid, splendid! Very good, nya~!」

688:t_3:131.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Well, $n? Now that you've heard all that, have you fallen into despair after all?」

688:t_3:132.en:
$n
「There is still hope.」
「There is only despair.」

688:t_3:133.en:
$n
「...Even so, I won't fall into despair...」

688:t_3:134.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's just what I'd expect from a warrior who surpassed hope and despair! Your infinite potential exceeded my calculations and expectations!」

688:t_3:137.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'd heard the rumors, but this man's obnoxiousness... is intolerable.」

688:t_3:139.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't believe someone like this was hiding among $c...」

688:t_3:140.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You don't even treat people as people! You're no different from the $$御使い$$s!」

688:t_3:141.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「W-Wait, nya~! We can talk this out!」

688:t_3:142.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't think we can trust someone who secretly cast suggestions on us that were practically mind control.」

688:t_3:143.en:
$$カレン$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ is just as bad! How could he let someone like this talk him around!?」

688:t_3:144.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I apologize for proceeding without telling you. And for the means we used.」

688:t_3:145.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, you've... been like that since the $$破界事変$$.」

688:t_3:146.en:
$$シモン$$
「If you think a just goal makes anything you do acceptable, you're dead wrong.」

688:t_3:147.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I won't make excuses. But I want you to know this much.」

688:t_3:148.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Every $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, including $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ and myself, truly intends to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:149.en:
$n
「The names of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons... and $$スヴェル$$... So you want Ragnarok from Norse mythology...」

688:t_3:150.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's just what I'd expect from an occult fanatic! You understand perfectly, nya~!」

688:t_3:151.en:
$$ベック$$
「So basically, this guy's got the same goal as me.」

688:t_3:152.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now I understand. You joined the Galactic Raid Fleet to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:153.en:
$$ベック$$
「Yeah... Even I felt that way after reading the final chapter of 'Metropolis.'」

688:t_3:154.en:
$$万丈$$
「The book $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$ wrote, depicting the end of the world...」

688:t_3:155.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$... Where did you read it?」

688:t_3:156.en:
$$ベック$$
「I met Miss $$エンジェル$$, and she showed it to me. While we're at it, she said the version I read had a newly rewritten final chapter.」

688:t_3:158.en:
$$ベック$$
「It was a real letdown. Believe it or not, the pages were blank.」

688:t_3:159.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... So that's the future that old man entrusted to us.」

688:t_3:160.en:
$$ベック$$
「Anyway! I ain't accepting the existence of people outside the world who think they're gods!」

688:t_3:161.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your mentality resembles that $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$'s. I can now understand his refusal to accept beings above himself, at least to a degree.」

688:t_3:162.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「If you understand, then everything's A-OK!」

688:t_3:163.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「With that lofty goal before us, the $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$s overcame differences in position, methods, and personality to become one like this, nya~.」

688:t_3:165.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I think you'll need our power in the battles ahead too, nya~.」

688:t_3:166.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The future our departed comrades entrusted to us... Please allow me to fight for it as well.」

688:t_3:172.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You mean the $$ＡＧ$$ costume, nya~?」

688:t_3:175.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... Putting this on really calms me down.」

688:t_3:178.en:
$n
「That was Boost Up combined with Jeet Kune Do. For now, we'll call that even for keeping secrets from us.」

688:t_3:183.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This time, I'll bend my principles as well.」

688:t_3:184.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$カレン$$... I'll leave my share to you and $$スザク$$.」
